newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ Bank shares in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ Bank shares in heavy trade.

text.p: Shares in Australia and New Banking Group Ltd saw heavy trade on Wednesday with 38.5 million shares or about 2.6 percent of its ordinary shares traded.

The bulk of the trade was in one line of 20 million shares specialled through County Natwest at a price of A$8.18 per shares. There was also heavy options-related trade prior to official market opening.

ANZ Bank has been speculated as a possible takeover target, particularly in a post-Wallis inquiry environment. But brokers said the trade was more likely an institutional shareholder taking advantage of ANZ Bank's near record high prices to sell.
The Wallis inquiry into the financial system is due conclude in March 1997.

The bank sector's attractive dividend yield was seen as enticing yield-hungry investors into the sector in numbers, they said. ANZ Bank shares closed two cents higher at A$8.18 on turnover of 43.3 million shares.
